payload.title: Sharing v2: cascade scoping + grantee leave-share
payload.description:
Follow-up to FR-1 (object-record sharing, DONE). Grants are object-record scoped only and do not cascade to related rows, streams, projections, blobs, jobs, search results, or arbitrary app routes (threat-model.md:128-130; status.md:72-75). There is also no grantee "leave share" endpoint — only the grant owner can revoke (threat-model.md:130; status.md:75).

Scope: a cascade-scoping model so a shared object's streams/projections/search/blobs/jobs respect the grant, plus a grantee leave-share / self-revocation flow. Size: M/L.
